questions.question:
If 'A' stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

321 A 3 C 11 B 10 D 19 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 321 A 3 C 11 B 10 D 19 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**321 ÷ 3**__ + 11 × 10 - 19 = ?

⇒ 107 + __**11 × 10**__ - 19 = ?

⇒ __**107 + 110**__ - 19 = ?

⇒ __217** - 19**__ = **198**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question:
S % T = S is the father of T.

X - W = X is the mother of W.

U * V = U is the sister of V.

Z + Y = Z is the husband of Y.

If A + J - B * V % G, find the relation between A and G.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 %
 
 
-

 
 
 
*

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Father
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 

Given: A + J - B * V % G 

A + J → A is the husband of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bfad6c9a29435b4dd0c032f4b209328d03147361827300e78132245c6f2a24b.png] 

J - B → J is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37e60c9b7e68da676980f0f41920f4e547f0d5988cfe54c2f6d18c06fc7337f6.png] 

B * V → B is the sister of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1d4df72193fdbc55907d9261bcaba4997a3401b230927bcf23f442c6987b15c.png] 

V % G → V is the father of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36db6979dda9865202cec8f6d2ca9144665eff2eaeb9ef2614d5bee41c3d25d2.png] 

Here, A is the parental grandfather of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some movies are videos.

No video is audio.

All audios are songs.

**Conclusions :**

(I) All movies can never be audios.

(II) No video is a song.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22491f1bd8b7bb505caa30d66308bcd6ee53f76920a9141950f5880473898e19.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All movies can never be audios → Follow (As some movies are videos and no video is audio. As some parts of movie are common with videos which can not be audio therefore all movies can never be audios is true)

II. No video is a song → Does not follow (As no video is audio and all Audio is song. So, no direct relation is given between video and song therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**"

questions.question: What will be the day on 31 December 2006 if 1 January 2006 is a Wednesday?
questions.solution:
Given: **1 January 2006** was Wednesday.

Now,

1 January 2006 to 1 January 2007 = 1 year (not a leap year)

Therefore, 1 January 2007 will be Wednesday + 1 = Thursday,

But, we need to find the day on 31 December 2006 which is 1 day before Thursday.

So, 31 December 2006 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
